what_this_is: the per-substrate predictions of this work's two arms on the evaluated test set, as the displays score them, so that the released grid carries every arm and not only the published predictors

convention.selection: the generator's top CAP candidates of the arm's pool
convention.fusion: H7 reciprocal rank fusion, k=60, over the generator and filter ranks
convention.parent_dropped: a prediction whose tautomer key equals the substrate's is removed, which is the convention every arm in the comparison is held to
convention.not_included: the generator and filter scores behind the ranking; a comparator's file carries its predictions and so does this one

reproduces.note: recomputed from the predictions below and from the released reference descriptors, and equal to the table's row at every budget; the producer refuses to write this file when it is not
